sentences.text: Caenagnathasia is a small theropod dinosaur belonging to the family Caenagnathidae, found in Uzbekistan during the Late Cretaceous.
The known jaw fragments are only a few centimeters long, with an estimated total skull length of 3 inches.
A 2010 estimate by Gregory S. Paul suggested the animal was 2 feet long and weighed 3 pounds.
The species Caenagnathasia martinsoni was named and described in 1994 by Philip J. Currie, Stephen Godfrey, and Lev Nessov.
The genus is based on the holotype specimen N 401/12457, which consists of a pair of fused lower jaw bones.
The holotype was found near Dzharakuduk in the Bissekty Formation around 90 million years ago, making Caenagnathasia the oldest known caenagnathoid.
New material including vertebrae, a dentary, and a femur was described in 2015 from the same site as the original holotype.
The time range for the genus is from the Turonian to the Campanian, between 93.9 and 72.2 million years ago.
